summary: This is an 8-K filing by Old National Bancorp announcing routine quarterly cash dividends on its common stock ($0.145/share) and preferred stock. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special-situation event. It is a standard dividend declaration and payment schedule with no structural changes or unusual terms. The board has declared the dividends payable on June 15 and August 20, 2026. There is no advisor, premium, or risk-arb angle. This is a routine current report that does not qualify as a special situation.
